description: Holds gold futures while the 50-day average is above the 200-day average, cash otherwise. Backtested on FinzData futures: each market is its front-month contract rolled on the FinzData roll calendar, as an excess-return index (no interest on collateral), 5 bps costs per trade, re-run free on full history.
title: /GC 50/200 moving-average trend
